description: Text generation allowance, queue wait, legacy speed gate records and job leases from app OTLP metrics on mimir-telemetry: how many text requests run free, how long registered requests wait for a worker, what an enforced speed gate would withhold from legacy text, and how leases renew and lapse.

panels.description: How many of the three always-recorded text allowance series (decisions, estimated wait, queue wait) reported in the last hour. 3 means the deployed release exports them. Dry-run quotes are not counted, so a quiet queue of quotes alone shows fewer.
panels.title: Allowance telemetry present

panels.description: p95 of the time from creation to assignment for registered users' non-chat text requests over the range. Registered stands in for requests paying kudos upfront; a registered request under the free allowance is free. Green below 60 s, red from 120 s. Shows COLLECTING below 200 assignments.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(horde_text_queue_wait_seconds_bucket{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_requester="registered", horde_chat="false"}[$__range])))) and on() (sum(increase(horde_text_queue_wait_seconds_count{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_requester="registered", horde_chat="false"}[$__range])) >= 200)

panels.title: Registered legacy queue wait p95

panels.description: Text requests created without kudos held upfront over all text creation decisions in the range. Shows COLLECTING below 200 decisions.
panels.title: Free share of text creations

panels.description: Share of free text requests that asked for more than 512 tokens. It is 0 while the free output ceiling is 512 and rises once the ceiling is raised, which confirms the configuration took effect. Shows COLLECTING below 200 free decisions.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(horde_text_free_allowance_decisions{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_outcome="free", horde_requested_bucket!="<=512"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(increase(horde_text_free_allowance_decisions{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_outcome="free"}[$__range])), 1)) and on() (sum(increase(horde_text_free_allowance_decisions{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_outcome="free"}[$__range])) >= 200)

panels.title: Free decisions above 512 tokens

panels.description: Text requests refused because the requester could not cover the upfront kudos, over all decisions in the range. Green below 2%, red from 5%. Shows COLLECTING below 200 decisions.
panels.title: Refused for kudos upfront

panels.description: Text requests whose max_length was lowered to the free allowance because the requester allowed it, over all decisions in the range. Green below 5%, red from 15%. Shows COLLECTING below 200 decisions.
panels.title: Downgraded to the allowance

panels.description: Legacy text jobs assigned to a worker too slow to finish them inside the base lease that were then aborted, over all such jobs that ended in the range. Compare with the all-text stale abort share beside it. Shows COLLECTING below 50 outcomes.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(horde_text_gate_shadow_outcomes{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_chat!="true", horde_outcome="aborted"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(increase(horde_text_gate_shadow_outcomes{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_chat!="true"}[$__range])), 1)) and on() (sum(increase(horde_text_gate_shadow_outcomes{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_chat!="true"}[$__range])) >= 50)

panels.title: Over-capacity legacy abort share

panels.description: Text and chat jobs aborted because their lease lapsed, over all text assignments in the range. Green below 2%, red from 5%. Shows COLLECTING below 200 assignments.
panels.title: All-text stale abort share

panels.description: Front completions over admitted front requests in the range. Green from 90%, red below 75%. Shows COLLECTING below 20 admitted.
panels.title: Chat delivered of admitted

panels.description: Relayed chat streams that ended in mismatch, replaced_attempt or gap, over all relayed streams. Green below 1%, red from 5%. Shows COLLECTING below 20 relayed streams.
panels.title: Relay divergence share

panels.description: Progress posts by untrusted workers' chat jobs that found the lease already at its cap, over all counted renewals for those workers. Green below 10%, red from 30%. Shows COLLECTING below 100 renewals.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(horde_text_lease_renewals{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_worker_trusted="false", horde_outcome="at_cap"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(increase(horde_text_lease_renewals{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_worker_trusted="false"}[$__range])), 1)) and on() (sum(increase(horde_text_lease_renewals{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_worker_trusted="false"}[$__range])) >= 100)

panels.title: Untrusted lease at-cap share

panels.description: Text and chat jobs assigned to workers over the range: the volume behind the shares on this row.
panels.title: Text assignments

panels.description: Every text request creation, dry runs excluded: free (no kudos held), funded (kudos reserved upfront), downgraded (max_length lowered to the allowance) and refused (KudosUpfront).
panels.title: Allowance decisions per hour, by outcome

panels.description: Free decisions over all decisions per requester kind (anonymous, registered, shared_key), 1-hour window.

targets.expr: sum by (horde_requester) (rate(horde_text_free_allowance_decisions{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_chat=~"$chat", horde_requester=~"$requester", horde_outcome="free"}[1h])) / clamp_min(sum by (horde_requester) (rate(horde_text_free_allowance_decisions{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_chat=~"$chat", horde_requester=~"$requester"}[1h])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Free share, by requester

panels.description: Free text requests over the range by the max_length they asked for. Sizes above <=512 are only free when the ceiling is above 512 and the estimated wait is short.
panels.title: Free decisions by requested size

panels.description: Every decision over the range by the allowance it was given. At a 512 ceiling every decision is <=512.
panels.title: Granted allowance by size

panels.description: API refusals for missing kudos: KudosUpfront for users, SharedKeyInsufficientKudos for shared keys and ChatKudosCapExceeded for chat requests over their max_kudos.
panels.title: Upfront kudos refusals per hour, by return code

panels.description: Distribution of the estimated wait at creation. Up to 60 s the allowance is the ceiling; it falls to the floor at 300 s. Not recorded when no worker is eligible.
panels.title: Estimated wait the allowance was sized by

panels.description: The estimated wait at creation, split by chat and legacy text, 15-minute window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, horde_chat) (rate(horde_text_free_allowance_estimated_wait_seconds_bucket{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_chat=~"$chat", horde_requester=~"$requester"}[15m])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, horde_chat) (rate(horde_text_free_allowance_estimated_wait_seconds_bucket{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_chat=~"$chat", horde_requester=~"$requester"}[15m])))

panels.title: Estimated wait p50 / p95

panels.description: Time from a text request's creation to a job's assignment, 15-minute window. Registered stands in for requests paying kudos upfront.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, horde_requester) (rate(horde_text_queue_wait_seconds_bucket{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_chat=~"$chat", horde_requester=~"$requester"}[15m])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, horde_requester) (rate(horde_text_queue_wait_seconds_bucket{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_chat=~"$chat", horde_requester=~"$requester"}[15m])))

panels.title: Queue wait p50 / p95, by requester

panels.description: p95 queue wait by the max_length requested, 15-minute window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, horde_requested_bucket) (rate(horde_text_queue_wait_seconds_bucket{job="ai-horde/ai-horde", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", horde_chat=~"$chat", horde_requester=~"$requester"}[15m])))

panels.title: Queue wait p95, by requested size

panels.description: One bar per day: p95 queue wait of registered users' non-chat text requests. Compare days before and after a change to the free output ceiling.
panels.title: Registered legacy queue wait p95, per day

panels.description: Text jobs assigned to workers per minute.
panels.title: Assignments per minute, by requester and chat
Speed gate for legacy text (recorded, not enforced)

panels.description: Legacy text jobs assigned to a worker whose measured speed does not finish their max_length inside the base lease. Legacy text is offered to any worker; chat jobs reach such a worker only when no capable one is online, shown in the next row.
panels.title: Over-capacity legacy assignments per hour, by size

panels.description: How over-capacity legacy text jobs ended over the range: completed, faulted or aborted, split by whether the worker's owner is trusted.
panels.title: Over-capacity outcomes, by trust

panels.description: Over-capacity legacy assignments over all legacy text assignments, 1-hour window: the share an enforced gate would withhold from the workers that took them.
panels.title: Would-refuse share of legacy assignments

panels.description: 6-hour windows. The all-text line includes chat jobs, since stale aborts are not split by chat.
panels.title: Abort share: over-capacity legacy against all text

panels.description: Pop to submit time of over-capacity legacy text jobs that completed, by size, 1-hour window. The base lease is 150 s; the buckets around it are 120 s and 180 s.
panels.title: Service time of completed over-capacity jobs, p50 / p95
Speed gate for chat (slower workers only when no capable one is online)

panels.description: Chat jobs assigned to a worker whose measured speed does not finish their max_tokens inside the base lease, because no capable worker for the model was online. Without such a worker the request would be refused as no_eligible_worker.
panels.title: Over-capacity chat assignments per hour, by size

panels.description: How over-capacity chat jobs ended over the range: completed, faulted or aborted on a lapsed lease, split by whether the worker's owner is trusted.
panels.title: Over-capacity chat outcomes, by trust

panels.description: Over-capacity chat assignments over all chat assignments, 1-hour window.
panels.title: Over-capacity share of chat assignments

panels.description: 6-hour windows. Over-capacity chat jobs aborted on a lapsed lease over all such jobs that ended, against stale aborts over assignments for all chat jobs. A job that does not post progress keeps the base lease of 150 s.
panels.title: Abort share: over-capacity chat against all chat

panels.description: Pop to submit time of over-capacity chat jobs that completed, by size, 1-hour window. The base lease is 150 s; progress posts extend it up to the trust cap.
panels.title: Service time of completed over-capacity chat jobs, p50 / p95

panels.description: Chat progress posts that extended the job lease (granted) or found it at its cap (at_cap). The cap is 600 s for trusted and 200 s for untrusted workers' owners.
panels.title: Lease renewals per minute, by outcome and trust

panels.description: at_cap over all counted renewals, 1-hour window.
panels.title: At-cap share of renewals, by trust

panels.description: Text and chat jobs aborted because their lease lapsed before a submit.
panels.title: Stale aborts per hour, by trust

panels.description: 1-hour window. Includes chat jobs.
